bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-ui-05849c)" || exit 62
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='link' AND step='preview' AND data->>'text'='個別編集済みの安全テスト' AND NOT (data ? 'shareCode') AND data::text LIKE '%一番目%';")" = 1 || exit 63
cd "$root"
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 64
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 1e5b41d236ea47de214ed29eeea9477bcec539a6 || exit 65
test "$(git hash-object scripts/userbot_link_rich_flow_smoke.py)" = "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_link_rich_flow_smoke.py)" || exit 66
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-link-register-e2e.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_test_client.py > "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" || exit 67
PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 68
if PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" link_rich_flow_smoke >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 69
 PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 70
 echo LINK_RICH_REGISTER_EDIT_E2E=PASS
 echo USERBOT_PRESERVED=PASS
else
 test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
 PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 72
 exit 80
fi
